en: Old black‑and‑white postcard view of a quiet village street with a cobblestone road in the foreground. On the right are simple one‑storey houses with steep tiled roofs, wooden framed windows with shutters, and plastered facades; one house appears more worn. A picket fence and dense bushes or trees run along the middle of the scene. There is a tall, thin wooden pole at the edge of the street, and a signboard above a window in the brick building partly hidden by foliage. The overall atmosphere is rural and early‑20th‑century.
